title: No 2 to 200 day GJ 536 residual peak passes a 1 percent tail test with 10 or 30 day noise blocks
abstract: We search 195 GJ 536 HARPS RVBank version 02 exposures for extra circular velocity waves from 2 to 200 days. Fixed fits include the two known planets, rotation terms, activity indices and instrument controls. The main residual peak is at 14.5408 days with amplitude 1.231 m/s. Full-search sign tests give tail fractions of 0.0005, 0.0440 and 0.0795 for 1, 10 and 30 day noise blocks. The peak is close to the known third rotation harmonic. Adding that harmonic leaves a 46.9463 day peak with tail fractions of 0.1210 and 0.1540 for 10 and 30 day blocks. No tested residual peak passes a 1 percent threshold with those longer blocks. Conditional injections at four periods recover 95 to 100 percent of 2 m/s waves on average over four phases, but only 10 to 15 percent at 1 m/s. Noise assumptions, fixed activity terms and shared spectra limit the result. No new planet or independent instrument confirmation is established. Code, fit aggregates, simulations, figures, source hashes and external retrieval steps are included.
